name: readFile
description: Read the content of a file owned by one of the workspace's gadgets. If a file changes after you read it, you will either be informed of the change or the outdated result will be replaced with a note telling you to re-read the file; otherwise there is no need to read a file again after you have already read it once. This cannot read chat attachments; attachments are provided directly in the conversation.

workpiece.description: Env binding name of the workpiece (e.g. gadget) that owns the file, as listed in the system prompt or chosen in createGadget.

filename.description: Name of the file to read.
